description: This file defines the ProjectAdminAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for listing available employees for project administration within the OrangeHRM time management module. It extends a generic Endpoint class, implements collection capabilities, and utilizes traits for employee service and user role management. It includes methods for retrieving employee data with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and contains OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
